title: Just the 'Facts, Part 2
description: Just the 'Facts, Part 2 — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Jerome's Bones

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Jerome's Bones

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Just the 'Facts, Part 3

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace. Kill Oroks until you obtain an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key, then unlock a nearby artifact chest. Bring the first artifact you find back to Jerome's bones in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

The artifact ya brought back didn't resurrect me. Maybe it wasn't mystical enough? Let's try it again, only this time go to Level 2 of the Shadow's Embrace t' kill Oroks fer an Artifact Chest Skeleton Key. Bring me back the first artifact ya find, will ya?

I figger that the artifacts on Level 2 gotta be more mystical than the ones on Level 1!

Turn-in:

Got another artifact? Good! Let's see if this one works!

Nope. I'm still skin and bones. But without the skin.

Objectives:

  • Retrieve Mystical Artifact ×1

Level range: 46–100
